name: piston_compressor_suction_drop_leakage
title: Piston compressor with inlet pressure drop and internal leakage
summary: Two-litre piston air compressor tested at 1500 rpm between 1 bar / 15 C suction and 5 bar discharge with identified overall efficiencies (0.75 / 0.55), dead-volume factor and proportional loss factor: the suction pressure drop and the internal leakage are modelled by equivalent isentropic nozzles whose areas are solved, the leak mixes back into the suction flow and the internal isentropic compression is closed by the clearance-volume volumetric efficiency; meant to be swept over speed.
